ValidationRule.description: Pre screener Cannot Change the Credit Pre screener result until Maker Result Send to Pre-screener
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Maker__c, 'Send to Pre-Screener')), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Supplementary Application") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pre-screener cannot change the Credit Pre-screening result until Maker Result is Send to Pre-screener
